analogy.rationale: Opioid receptors (OPRM1, OPRK1, OPRD1) are Gi-coupled GPCRs expressed at low levels in most of these cell lines, so opioid agonists should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other GPCR-targeting classes, especially opioid antagonists and general GPCR antagonists, which share receptor family and downstream signaling but also produce minimal effects in these cells.
